name: TestFlight release candidate
userOutcome: The owner can install Svara, enter without an account, access every bundled content item without payment, complete and retain a practice or lesson, and hear bundled mantra audio start automatically after beginning an applicable daily practice.
productionDataSource: Bundled reviewed JSON and audio assets, local UserDefaults and Documents persistence, and UserNotifications. StoreKit remains dormant while the testing build is free.
errorBehavior: Failures remain scoped to the operation, preserve progress and input, and present user-safe recovery copy. The current build must not show a Plus surface or restrict bundled content.
accessibilityRequirements: VoiceOver labels and order on primary workflows
Dynamic Type without unreachable primary actions
prohibitedBehavior: No arbitrary-credential or fake account flow.
No persisted profile flag as premium authority.
No Plus, paywall, membership, purchase, or restricted-content surface while plusTierEnabled is false.
No StoreKit test configuration in the production bundle.
No unreviewed cultural content or audio rights claim.
No claim of a free trial without verified eligibility.
acceptanceTests: All unit and UI smoke tests pass on a clean iOS simulator.
A Release build and unsigned archive complete with product validation.
The archived bundle contains PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy and excludes Svara.storekit.
Every bundled lesson opens from Learn and Today without a paywall in the free testing configuration.
Every authored recording is bundled in an Apple-decodable format; applicable Today practices start audio on Begin and expose play/pause only during the active practice.
A physical-device pass covers audio interruption, notifications, and VoiceOver.
Content and audio receive recorded human review before external testing.
The signed final build uploads and finishes App Store Connect processing.
The sole owner installs the declared internal-only build through TestFlight and completes the bounded TF-015 smoke without claiming external readiness.
Any future monetized build completes TF-005 and TF-012 before exposing Plus.
The internally verified build passes TestFlight App Review before external testers receive access.
